## Problem

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and the responsible code path.

## Retail evidence

Describe the xemu, hardware, executable-analysis or trace evidence used to establish the expected behavior. Clearly mark inferred names.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit checks pass.
